recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. No additional core FHIR change is needed unless HL7 changes the application-registration mechanism or decides to add new substantive FMM content beyond this non-substantive link repair.
issue_request: FHIR-45946 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-core clarification requesting that the versions.html#maturity link text "register their implementations" no longer point to the stale fhir.org usage page, and that the adjacent maturity-metrics link avoid a page that only redirects readers onward.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-45946 was present before reconciliation. The current source/versions.html maturity paragraph still used http://fhir.org/implementations/usage and http://hl7.org/fhir/maturity-metrics. Earlier FHIR-33957 work had replaced a deleted Google Sheet with the hl7.org maturity-metrics permalink, but did not apply this later cleanup.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2024-07-08 record FHIR-45946 as Persuasive, 7-0-0, with direction to update the link and add content for the FMM matrix. The current fhir.org usage page states that registering implementations is not possible at this time, while https://fhir.org/implementations/registry/ serves the FHIR application registry. The hl7.org maturity-metrics page contains only a link to the Confluence Maturity Model Analysis page. source/versioning.html repeats the same implementation-registration wording and is part of the same root version-management source content.
reconciliation: Edited source/versions.html to link directly from the maturity section to the FHIR application registry and Confluence Maturity Model Analysis page. Also updated the duplicate implementation-registration wording in source/versions.html and source/versioning.html to use the same direct registry link.
source_changes: source/versions.html: replaced the maturity paragraph's stale fhir.org implementation usage link with https://fhir.org/implementations/registry/ and made the link text identify the FHIR application registry.
source/versions.html: replaced the redirect-only http://hl7.org/fhir/maturity-metrics link with the direct Confluence Maturity Model Analysis URL.
source/versions.html and source/versioning.html: updated duplicated implementation-registration guidance to link to the FHIR application registry instead of the obsolete usage page.
